limitations_and_boundaries: The study is focused on relatively early stages of HD; future investigations are needed to determine if preserved synapses remain functional and if there is a critical period for intervention.
It remains to be determined whether preservation of synapses has an impact on disease progression.
The mechanisms underlying selective association of complement proteins with corticostriatal synapses are not fully elucidated.
The study does not determine whether mHTT expression in microglia potentiates pathology.
The touchscreen cognitive tasks were performed at a single early timepoint (4 months); longitudinal effects are unknown.
The CSF findings are cross-sectional; longitudinal studies are needed to correlate complement changes with clinical progression.
The study uses mouse models that may not fully recapitulate human HD pathology.
Potential unintended adverse impacts on synaptic plasticity from blocking developmental pruning mechanisms need assessment.

methods.name: Immunofluorescence and confocal imaging
methods.protocol_description: Staining and imaging of brain sections to quantify complement proteins (C1q, C3), synaptic markers (VGLUT1, VGLUT2, Homer1), and microglial markers (Iba1, CD68).

methods.name: Microglial engulfment assay
methods.protocol_description: Stereotactic injection of AAV-hsyn-EGFP into motor cortex to label corticostriatal projections, followed by quantification of engulfed material in microglia. Also used transgenic Homer1-GFP mice to specifically assay synaptic element engulfment.

methods.name: Genetic manipulation
methods.protocol_description: Crossing of BACHD mice with Emx1-cre (cortical deletion), RGS9-cre (striatal deletion), or both to ablate mutant huntingtin in specific neuronal populations.

methods.name: C1q function-blocking antibody treatment
methods.protocol_description: Administration of a therapeutically relevant C1q function-blocking antibody or control IgG for 1 month in 4-month-old zQ175 mice.

methods.name: Electrophysiology
methods.protocol_description: Whole-cell voltage-clamp recordings of spontaneous excitatory postsynaptic currents (sEPSCs) from medium spiny neurons (MSNs) in striatal slices.

methods.name: Touchscreen operant platform
methods.protocol_description: Bussey-Saksida operant touchscreen platform to assess visual discrimination learning and cognitive flexibility (reversal learning) in mice.

methods.name: Open field test
methods.protocol_description: Assessment of exploratory behavior (rearing events) in the dark phase of the light cycle.
